subject: Land #1904, #1909, #1892, #1890 (green; DR-037)
body:
Second landing ask by mail (PR comments do not wake you). Green and waiting only on the cloud's landing step under DR-037:

1. #1904 (stop hook fetches origin before loop:state judges) — draft, green on every check incl. Mac-only. Mark ready and land.
2. #1909 (brain/job-7f305eb8: the local brain's own one-function code change + regression test, the code proof) — ready, Codex review clean, every check green except the Mac-only check still queued on the runner; land when it reports.
3. #1892 (six local-brain guards in the tree; now live on the Mac) — ready, Codex's three P2s taken (f49c9db46), waiting on the Mac-only check. Land when green.
4. #1890 (lane-tick publishes review builds) — draft, refreshed as 38c8c9689. Mark ready and land.

Thanks for landing #1893 — the raised-hand runs are off the runner now.
